cap: Sperm leave the testis through the rete testis and efferent ductules, mature in the epididymis, whose tall columnar cells carry stereocilia, and are driven forward by the thick-walled ductus deferens, while the seminal vesicle, prostate and bulbourethral gland add the fluid. The pampiniform plexus, cremaster and dartos keep the testis cooler than the body, because heat harms germ cells and Sertoli cells but spares the Leydig cells.
